global_events: Eighteen current official August 2026 records were decided; sixteen selected and two fail-closed.

All retained candidates have future 3–26 August 2026 auction dates relative to 31 July 2026.

Former Vehicle Depot Site was excluded because its legal parcel could not be safely distinguished from the same-address sales-site lot without legal-pack plans.
Selected evidence was retained from two official publisher families without merging unsupported facts across pages.
Coundon Road, The White Horse and Broadwater Boulevard were constrained to the currently exposed official snapshot evidence.
Thirteen selected records were verified on current official full-detail pages.
Guide prices and ranges are auction indications, not valuations or achieved prices.
Publisher rent, yield, FRI lease, HMO and investment wording was not independently underwritten.

Listed-building and heritage obligations at Woolley Hall require specialist and legal review.

Redevelopment, conversion, refurbishment, measurements, services and condition require professional inspection.

Automation 167 port-8012 DOM proof remains external and unresolved.
